title: Let Us Go to the House of the Lord

questions.question: I was glad when they said to me, "Let us go to the house of the what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 122:1 (ESV): "I was glad when they said to me, 'Let us go to the house of the Lord!'"

questions.question: Our feet have been standing within your gates, O where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 122:2 (ESV): "Our feet have been standing within your gates, O Jerusalem!"

questions.question: Jerusalem—built as a city that is bound firmly what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 122:3 (ESV): "Jerusalem—built as a city that is bound firmly together,"

questions.question: To which the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord, as was decreed for whom?
Pray for the peace of where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 122:6 (ESV): "Pray for the peace of Jerusalem!"

questions.question: May they be secure who do what to you?
questions.explanation: Psalm 122:6 (ESV): "May they be secure who love you!"

questions.question: Peace be within your walls and security within your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 122:7 (ESV): "Peace be within your walls and security within your towers!"

questions.question: For my brothers and companions' sake I will say, "Peace be within where?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 122:8 (ESV): "...I will say, 'Peace be within you!'"

questions.question: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I will seek your what?
There thrones for judgment were set, the thrones of the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 122:5 (ESV): "...the thrones of the house of David."

questions.question: Who is the author of Psalm 122?
questions.explanation: Psalm 122 Title: "A Song of Ascents. Of David."

questions.question: What do the tribes give thanks to?
questions.explanation: Psalm 122:4 (ESV): "...to give thanks to the name of the Lord."

questions.question: The city is described as being bound firmly what?
What were set there according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalm 122:5 (ESV): "There thrones for judgment were set,"

questions.question: What reason is given for seeking Jerusalem's good in verse 9?
options: For the sake of the house of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: For the sake of the house of the Lord
questions.explanation: Psalm 122:9 (ESV): "For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I will seek your good."

key_verse_text: I was glad when they said to me, "Let us go to the house of the Lord!"
